sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioner is an accused in connection with G.R. Case No.029 of 2023, pending before the learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Berhampur, arising out of Nimakhandi P.S. No.056 of 2023, for alleged commission of offences under Sections 363/366/376(2)(n)/34 of IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act.

3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned ADJ-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Berhampur, by order dated 11.05.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the petitioner is in custody since 15.02.2023 and since charge-sheet has been filed in the meanwhile, further continuance of the petitioner in custody is unwarranted.

5. Perused the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim which is on record.
6.
Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.

7. Considering the nature of allegation, the tenor of 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim and filing of charge sheet, this Court directs the petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the Suraj Sahu @ Surajit vs State Of Odisha ....
